choices.reasoning: Surveillance Team is the least useful card in the opening hand. The other cards are all immediately useful: Backflip prevents all damage from an attack (critical for survivability), Mockingbird stuns the enemy, Aunt May heals 4 damage, Spider-Tracer and Interrogation Room provide threat removal tied to minions that may appear later. Discarding Surveillance Team leaves the more powerful options in hand.

Playing Emergency during the villain phase reduces the threat the villain places when it schemes. Rhino is about to scheme (its scheme action is in progress), and its scheme will add threat to the main scheme. Playing Emergency now will reduce that threat by 1, preventing damage to the main scheme and keeping us further from the losing threshold of 7. This is the best available action — it directly addresses the threat accumulation that is the primary loss condition.

Changing to Spider-Man now stops the engaged Hydra Mercenary from attacking me (in hero form, only the villain attacks). This is better than staying in alter-ego form, where the minion would attack me for 1 damage each round while I also have to deal with the threat.
